title: linxiaotu
summary: A personal grab-bag repository of unrelated projects (a quantitative trading system, AI engineering guides, and vendored third-party tool collections). Among the vendored materials is an MCP server (sdv-mcp) that exposes SDV's multi-table synthesizer as a callable tool: SDV's HMASynthesizer and Metadata/evaluate_quality API are invoked to fit, sample, and score synthetic data on demand for an AI agent.
needs: The sdv-mcp folder appears to be a vendored copy from an external 'ai-engineering-hub' project rather than original work of this repository's owner; unclear if actively maintained here.
